name: NeuroMorph: A High-Temporal Resolution MEG Dataset for Morpheme-Based Linguistic Analysis
readme:
KIT/Yokogawa MEG system with 208 magnetometer channels
24 subjects amounting to over 17 hours of data
Supplementary code can be found [here](github.com/amilleah/neuromorph)
